description: The runner's state of record for one run (sync/runner/records.py). Born as {run_id, job, shape, state: starting, started_at, resumed} at launch (sync/runner/main.py); fields accrue over the run's life. Terminal states are exactly complete | failed | orphaned; a terminal transition appends exactly one run-terminal event to var/ui-outbox.jsonl, guarded by the terminal_event_state stamp. S5 adds the venue key (plan §7 V1) — absent at the pin.

last_evidence_at.description: Exists on every record from its first save (initialized to started_at); only successful session reads refresh it.

state.description: Non-terminal states include starting and running; terminal states are exactly the three named in the contract.

venue.description: The venue the run belongs to (S5, plan §7 V1): stamped at write time by the extracted core, and on the legacy stock by the §10.3 one-time migration; no reader defaults it.

title: Run record (results/runs/<run_id>.json)
